  Problem: The jq expression in format_diagnose_trace_section performs string concatenation on evidence_trace fields without type-guarding the operands. Specifically, `" in " + .function` and `" — " + .observation` will abort jq with "string and <type> cannot be added" if the Codex model returns a non-string value (number, object, array) for these fields. The normalize_diagnose_result_contract_fields function only checks whether evidence_trace is an array and hypothesis is a string — it does not validate entry-level field types. Under set -euo pipefail, the command substitution at line 776 (`EXISTING_TRACE_SECTION="$(format_diagnose_trace_section ...)"`) propagates the jq failure and terminates the script before the fallback issue creation logic at lines 777-798 executes.
  Why it fails at runtime: The diagnose flow is: (1) Codex returns valid JSON with valid top-level types but a non-string value in evidence_trace[].function (e.g., an integer), (2) extract_last_json_with_key succeeds, (3) normalize passes (array type matches, hypothesis type matches), (4) diagnose_result_meets_trace_contract passes (evidence_trace non-empty, hypothesis non-empty), so DIAGNOSE_SUCCESS=true, (5) later, FIX_COUNT is 0 due to empty fix_issues, entering the empty-fix-issues fallback at line 771, (6) format_diagnose_trace_section calls jq which aborts on the non-string concatenation, (7) set -e terminates the script. No fallback fix-up issue is created. The orchestrator sees handled as unset/false and has no diagnostic artifact to act on.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  Location: format_diagnose_trace_section function, jq format_trace_entry definition (lines 689-704)
  Issue: Type-unsafe concatenation of evidence_trace fields that may be non-string JSON types
  Suggested minimal fix: Use `tostring` filter to safely convert fields before concatenation:
```jq
def format_trace_entry:
  "- "
  + ((.file // "<unknown file>") | tostring)
  + (if .line == null then "" else ":" + (.line | tostring) end)
  + (if (((.function // "") | tostring) == "") then "" else " in " + (.function | tostring) end)
  + " — "
  + (((.observation // "") | tostring) | if length > 0 then . else "No observation provided." end);
```
